name: Pastel Gore

summary: Pastel Gore is a visual art style that emerged from the internet art community around the late-2010s and is defined by the juxtaposition of graphic, horror-themed imagery with a soft, pastel color palette and cute motifs.
description: Pastel Gore is a visual art style that emerged from the internet art community around the late-2010s and is defined by the juxtaposition of graphic, horror-themed imagery with a soft, pastel color palette and cute motifs. The aesthetic depicts subjects such as blood, organs, and dismemberment in a stylized, cartoonish manner, using bright and desaturated colors to create a contrast between the disturbing subject matter and its innocent presentation. It draws influence from Japanese art styles like Gurokawa and aesthetics such as Pastel Goth .
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): Juxtaposition, body horror, cuteness, artistic expression
